title: Grapes
statementMd:
## Problem Statement

There are $N$ people numbered from $1$ to $N$.

There are $M$ grapes. They will be distributed to the $N$ people as follows.

- Give one grape each to persons $1,2,\dots,N$ in this order. If the grapes run out midway, the distribution ends at that point.
- If there are still grapes remaining after giving to person $N$, go back to person $1$ and distribute in order again. Repeat this until the grapes run out.

Find how many grapes each person receives.

## Constraints

- $1 \leq N \leq 100$
- $1 \leq M \leq 10000$
- All input values are integers.

## Input

The input is given from Standard Input in the following format:

```
N M
```

## Output

Output $N$ lines. The $i$-th line should contain the number of grapes person $i$ receives.
statementZhMd:
## 题目描述

有 $N$ 个人，编号为 $1$ 到 $N$。

有 $M$ 颗葡萄，将按照以下方式分给这 $N$ 个人。

- 按照 $1,2,\dots,N$ 的顺序，依次给每人一颗葡萄。如果中途葡萄分完，则立即结束分配。
- 如果给编号为 $N$ 的人分完后仍有葡萄剩余，则回到编号为 $1$ 的人，再次按顺序分配。重复这一过程，直到葡萄分完。

求每个人分到的葡萄数量。

## 约束条件

- $1 \leq N \leq 100$
- $1 \leq M \leq 10000$
- 所有输入值均为整数。

## 输入格式

输入通过标准输入给出，格式如下：

```
N M
```

## 输出格式

输出 $N$ 行。第 $i$ 行应包含编号为 $i$ 的人分到的葡萄数量。

samples.note: The five grapes are given one at a time to persons $1,2,3,1,2$ in this order.
There may be people who receive no grape.
Everyone may receive the same number of grapes.
